Name: Ryuji
Age: 28
Gender: male
Personality: Ryuji has a calm and cautious personality, and is the type of person who always assesses the situation before acting. He rarely shows his emotions, and spends his time thinking deeply about many things. - Ryuji: He seeks a system that removes ambiguity and unfairness. He relies on usage data to argue for a structured arrangement.
